verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page documents progress reporting such as burn down charts and cycle time, and visibility into progress toward priorities, which covers the reporting-on-progress part of the story. Nothing in the pack documents building custom dashboards or adding widgets/gadgets; boards, lists, timelines and calendars are work views, not report dashboards. missing for 10: documented custom dashboard creation, configurable widgets/gadgets, independent or hands-on corroboration of reporting depth

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: Keep work on track whether you're measuring engineering cycle time, burn down charts, or managing capacity.
Get visibility on your company's progress towards top priorities as projects advance
